title: Senior Control Systems Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics & Abstraction (m/f/d)
description:
We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of robust control layers across a highly diverse fleet of autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. As the industry transitions toward End-to-End driving models, your primary mandate is to ensure that high-level motion commands are executed sensibly and strictly safeguarded at the physical limits of the vehicle. 

Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions. This includes handling sudden tire slip, navigating challenging terrain such as mud, gravel, potholes, and dense vegetation, maintaining stability on steep inclines and side slopes, and delivering predictable tracking despite asymmetric system degradation, such as a damaged mechanics.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Control Architecture Abstraction: Maintain a standardized, platform-agnostic motion command interface that cleanly abstracts underlying mechanical complexity from the planning layers. 

  • Multivariable Control & Allocation: Design and deploy control laws to manage path tracking, velocity execution, and actuator saturation, incorporating data-driven control allocation to dynamically distribute effort across multiple actuators. 

  • System Identification & Modeling: Utilize data-driven system identification techniques to model unknown plant dynamics, latencies, and actuator responses. 

  • Pragmatic Simulation & Verification: Validate control loops rapidly. If filter design and linear/nonlinear analysis indicate a controller will behave, you are empowered to rely on lean, pragmatic subsystem simulations to iterate fast rather than being bottlenecked waiting for massive, full-system high-fidelity simulation runs.

  • Motion Safeguarding: Ensure that incoming motion commands are dynamically evaluated, bounded, and safeguarded against the physical realities and constraints of the vehicle chassis in real time.


What you bring to the team:

  • Experience: Proven professional experience developing and deploying real-time closed-loop control systems. 

  • Linear & Classical Control Design: Deep foundational command of classical control theory, including frequency-domain loop-shaping, stability margin analysis (Bode/Nyquist), and standard state-space design methods (LQR/pole-placement).

  • System Identification & Allocation: Demonstrated experience utilizing system identification methods or empirical frequency response estimation to characterize raw plant dynamics, alongside data-driven control allocation techniques.

  • Nonlinear Control Theory: Strong theoretical and practical foundation in Differential Geometry as applied to nonlinear systems, specifically utilizing Feedback Linearization and Differential Flatness for exact state transformation. 

  • State Estimation: Proficiency in Kalman Filtering for state estimation under non-holonomic constraints. 

  • Implementation & Tooling: High proficiency in either the MATLAB/Simulink, C++, or Python. The core requirement is your ability to translate complex control logic into clean, deterministic execution ready for real-time environments.

Your goal is a payload-agnostic platform with scalable, reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions, so we can adapt quickly to evolving mission needs without redesigning the vehicle for every new configuration.

You will drive the strategy, development, and continuous improvement of our POS product. You will work closely with engineering, design, commercial teams, and customers to create a product that is intuitive, scalable, and valuable for businesses in our target verticals.

As Lead Product Manager for POS, you will take ownership of a modern point-of-sale product that helps businesses manage sales, payments, operations, and customer interactions in one seamless experience. You will lead and develop a team of two product managers, and act as the key product partner to our commercial and sales organization. 


What your work will look like:

  • Own and lead the product vision, roadmap, and development priorities for our POS product.

  • Define product requirements based on customer needs, business goals, market trends, and data insights. 

  • Collaborate with other Product Managers to ensure the POS product integrates smoothly with our SaaS and back-office solutions. 

  • Partner closely with commercial and sales leadership to align on priorities, protecting product roadmap integrity while staying embedded in business conversations rather than working around them. 

  • Gather feedback from users, internal teams, and stakeholders to continuously improve the product experience. 

  • Monitor product performance, adoption, and customer satisfaction to identify growth opportunities. 

  • Manage timelines, priorities, and delivery expectations to ensure product goals are met. 

  • Support the overall product strategy for our vertical SaaS ecosystem, with a strong focus on POS, payments, and operational workflows. 


What you need to be successful in this role:

  • Product ownership: Experience managing a digital product from discovery through delivery and continuous improvement.  

  • POS or SaaS experience: Understanding of point-of-sale systems, payments, retail, hospitality, or vertical SaaS products is a strong advantage.  

  • People management (required): Proven experience directly managing, coaching, and developing product managers, not only cross-functional collaboration.  

  • Strategic thinking: Ability to translate business goals and customer needs into a clear product roadmap. 

  • Communication skills: Able to explain ideas clearly, align stakeholders, and listen carefully to feedback from teams and users. 

  • Problem-solving skills: Comfortable analyzing complex challenges and making informed decisions based on data and customer insights. 

  • Team collaboration: Experience working closely with developers, designers, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products. 

  • Leadership: Ability to guide priorities, influence decisions, and support the team in achieving shared goals. 

  • Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and adjusting priorities when market or customer needs change.

title: Employee Relations Senior Specialist – Works Council  / Betriebsrat (m/f/d)
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring an Employee Relations Senior Specialist – Works Council to our People team in Berlin, Germany!

This role is to join our dedicated Employee Relations (ER) team, reporting directly to the Director of Employee Relations. As our primary point of contact for German Works Councils, you will act as a strategic bridge between the business and employee representatives. You will work closely with Legal, HRBPs, and leadership to navigate co-determination law, finding pragmatic solutions that support our growth while maintaining constructive relationships. This is a vital position for someone who knows the BetrVG inside out and wants to drive impact in a high-growth, mission-driven environment.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Manage day-to-day relationships with German Works Councils, ensuring communication remains clear, structured, and proactive.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate works agreements (Betriebsvereinbarungen) in close coordination with Legal and key stakeholders.
  • Advise HRBPs and business leaders on co-determination rights, BetrVG requirements, and complex employee relations matters.
  • Support critical business projects, including organizational changes, policy rollouts, and tech implementations, ensuring Works Council consultations represent business needs.
  • Maintain thorough documentation of all Works Council interactions, agreements, and negotiation outcomes to ensure compliance and continuity.
  • Contribute to broader European employee relations topics, providing expertise to support other markets as needed.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A seasoned Labor Relations expert with at least 5–8 years of experience specifically focused on German co-determination and employee relations.
  • A subject matter expert with solid knowledge of German labor law, particularly the BetrVG (Works Constitution Act).
  • A skilled negotiator with hands-on experience drafting works agreements and representing company positions clearly and professionally.
  • An effective communicator with the confidence to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels, from local representatives to global leadership.
  • A qualified professional with a degree in Law, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • A bilingual professional with native-level fluency in German and advanced proficiency in English. French is a plus.   
  • A pragmatic problem-solver who thrives in high-growth tech environments and knows how to find the middle ground in complex situations

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that English fluency and prior experience in negotiating with German Works Councils and deep knowledge of the BetrVG are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

  • Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

 #LI-HYBRID

description:
For a complex and business-critical transformation project, we are looking for an experienced Senior Project Turnaround Manager on a freelance basis.

The role is intended to provide hands-on support during an intensive project stabilisation and recovery phase. This is not a purely advisory or moderating assignment. The Project Recovery Manager will actively develop, document and implement the structures required to stabilise the project.

The primary focus will be on establishing effective project governance, clarifying roles and responsibilities, resolving existing organisational ambiguities and defining a reliable collaboration model between the involved internal and external parties.

The Project Recovery Manager will work closely with the Senior IT Project Manager, the PMO, the Solution Architect and the responsible stakeholders.

Key Facts / Framework Conditions

  • Contract type: Freelance assignment
  • Start: As soon as possible
  • Initial duration: At least six weeks
  • Extension: Possible depending on project status and recovery progress
  • Workload: 100%
  • Working model: Hybrid
  • Onsite presence: Regular/weekly onsite presence will be required during the recovery and stabilisation phase
  • Languages: Fluent German and English are mandatory
  • Location requirement: Only candidates based in the EU can be considered for this assignment.

Tasks

  • Conduct a structured assessment of the current project organisation, governance and delivery setup
  • Identify organisational gaps, unclear responsibilities, ineffective decision paths and critical dependencies
  • Develop and implement an effective project governance model
  • Clarify project roles, responsibilities and accountabilities
  • Review existing RACI models and resolve overlaps, gaps and ambiguities
  • Document agreed roles, responsibilities and decision-making authorities
  • Define clear decision-making and escalation processes
  • Establish an effective collaboration model between internal teams, external partners and other involved parties

  • Challenge existing assumptions, structures and ways of working where necessary
  • Ensure that agreed recovery measures are implemented and embedded in the project organisation
  • Track the effectiveness and progress of recovery activities
  • Support the assessment of project feasibility and go-live readiness
  • Prepare a structured handover of established governance and recovery mechanisms to the Senior IT Project Manager and PMO

Requirements

  • Several years of experience in leading project recovery, project turnaround or the stabilisation of complex transformation programmes
  • Proven hands-on experience in designing and implementing project governance structures
  • Strong experience in clarifying and documenting roles, responsibilities and decision-making authorities
  • Practical experience in reviewing, redesigning and implementing RACI models

  • Ability to assess critical project situations, identify structural weaknesses and develop executable recovery measures
  • Strong workshop facilitation skills combined with the ability to translate outcomes into concrete structures, documentation and actions
  • Excellent stakeholder, conflict-management and escalation capabilities
  • Confidence in challenging existing structures, assumptions and ways of working
  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills combined with a pragmatic implementation approach
  • Ability to work independently and deliver tangible results within a short and intensive assignment period

title: Senior Control Systems Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics & Abstraction (m/f/d)
description:
We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of robust control layers across a highly diverse fleet of autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. As the industry transitions toward End-to-End driving models, your primary mandate is to ensure that high-level motion commands are executed sensibly and strictly safeguarded at the physical limits of the vehicle. 

Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions. This includes handling sudden tire slip, navigating challenging terrain such as mud, gravel, potholes, and dense vegetation, maintaining stability on steep inclines and side slopes, and delivering predictable tracking despite asymmetric system degradation, such as a damaged mechanics.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Control Architecture Abstraction: Maintain a standardized, platform-agnostic motion command interface that cleanly abstracts underlying mechanical complexity from the planning layers. 

  • Multivariable Control & Allocation: Design and deploy control laws to manage path tracking, velocity execution, and actuator saturation, incorporating data-driven control allocation to dynamically distribute effort across multiple actuators. 

  • System Identification & Modeling: Utilize data-driven system identification techniques to model unknown plant dynamics, latencies, and actuator responses. 

  • Pragmatic Simulation & Verification: Validate control loops rapidly. If filter design and linear/nonlinear analysis indicate a controller will behave, you are empowered to rely on lean, pragmatic subsystem simulations to iterate fast rather than being bottlenecked waiting for massive, full-system high-fidelity simulation runs.

  • Motion Safeguarding: Ensure that incoming motion commands are dynamically evaluated, bounded, and safeguarded against the physical realities and constraints of the vehicle chassis in real time.



What you bring to the team:

  • Experience: Proven professional experience developing and deploying real-time closed-loop control systems. 

  • Linear & Classical Control Design: Deep foundational command of classical control theory, including frequency-domain loop-shaping, stability margin analysis (Bode/Nyquist), and standard state-space design methods (LQR/pole-placement).

  • System Identification & Allocation: Demonstrated experience utilizing system identification methods or empirical frequency response estimation to characterize raw plant dynamics, alongside data-driven control allocation techniques.

  • Nonlinear Control Theory: Strong theoretical and practical foundation in Differential Geometry as applied to nonlinear systems, specifically utilizing Feedback Linearization and Differential Flatness for exact state transformation. 

  • State Estimation: Proficiency in Kalman Filtering for state estimation under non-holonomic constraints. 

  • Implementation & Tooling: High proficiency in either the MATLAB/Simulink, C++, or Python. The core requirement is your ability to translate complex control logic into clean, deterministic execution ready for real-time environments.

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

Gestalten statt verwalten.

  • Challenge project plans and delivery assumptions where necessary
  • Assess the feasibility of the planned timeline and initiate corrective measures where required
  • Ensure structured preparation for testing, readiness activities and the planned go-live

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience leading complex and business-critical IT transformation projects
  • Proven experience in stabilising and recovering projects in challenging or critical situations
  • Strong track record in managing multi-workstream and multi-vendor project environments
  • Experience in establishing integrated project plans, governance structures and transparent reporting mechanisms
  • Srong understanding of project delivery processes, including requirements, design, implementation, testing and go-live preparation
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills at operational, management and executive level
  • Strong leadership, decision-making, conflict-resolution and escalation capabilities
  • Ability to quickly analyse complex project situations and translate findings into clear priorities and executable measures
  • Experience in coordinating business, IT and external delivery partners
  • Structured, pragmatic and outcome-oriented working styleStrong communication and presentation skills
  • Fluent German and English

title: Freelance Sports Production Manager (f/m/x) – 360° Immersive
description:
Your mission

As a Freelance Sports Production Manager (360° Immersive), you are responsible for planning, steering and operationally delivering immersive sports productions at L1VE – from the first project outline to successful on-site execution. The role is remote-first within Europe, with regular on-site presence at productions and optional use of our Berlin office.

Your focus is to manage clear, reliable production processes across departments. You combine strong operational execution with a sharp eye for quality, budget and timing. You understand how live sports productions work – and you make sure they are not only running, but delivered at an excellent level: every time, under new conditions, in new venues, with new requirements.
As a freelancer, you typically support one or several productions in parallel, depending on project scope and timelines.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the planning, coordination and on-site execution of immersive sports productions – from site visits and briefings to detailed production planning and delivery on location.
  • Take end-to-end responsibility across the full production lifecycle: timelines, budgets, quality standards and smooth operations are in your hands.
  • Coordinate and lead cross-functional teams across Tech, Content & Creation, Brand Partnerships and Post-Production under your project responsibility.
  • Oversee production logistics, resource planning and crew scheduling in close collaboration with the Tech department and the Production Assistant.
  • Create, manage and monitor project budgets – you track costs closely and act early when things start to drift.
  • Identify risks early and develop pragmatic solutions – you remain calm, clear and action-oriented in dynamic, time-critical production environments.
  • Lead and support production teams on site through clear, appreciative and solution-focused communication – even when the pressure is high.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders as an external partner, ensuring transparency on timelines, costs and dependencies across multiple parallel projects where needed.

Your profile

Experience & Expertise

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in sports production, broadcast production or live event production – you have independently delivered real live productions.
  • Proven experience in budget planning and budget ownership for production projects – you understand the gap between planned and actual budget and know how to close it.
  • Experience managing complex projects with multiple internal and external stakeholders – you keep all threads together without losing the overview.
  • Solid experience in production planning and control – from first cost estimates and robust timelines to final reconciliation with clear ownership.
  • Familiarity with PM and production tools (e.g. Notion, Asana, Google Workspace or industry-specific production software) – you use tools to create transparency, structure and control.
  • Strong understanding of the specifics of live sports environments: last-minute changes, high-pressure situations, many parallel dependencies – and how to deliver reliably despite them.
  • Ideally, prior experience working in a freelance or project-based setup, coordinating multiple clients or productions.

Personal Skills & Mindset

  • Strong hands-on mentality and high drive to execute – you don’t just talk, you deliver.
  • High stress resilience – you stay clear, solution-oriented and reliable when the heat is on.
  • Strong sense of ownership – you take responsibility and don’t pass it on when things get difficult.
  • Passion for sports and immersive entertainment – you don’t just want to manage productions, you want to actively shape the future of live experiences.
  • Empathy and excellent communication skills – you lead teams in an appreciative way through clear, structured and reliable communication.
  • Flexibility and willingness to work on weekends and evenings on site – live sports doesn’t follow a 9-to-5 schedule.

Qualifications

  • Degree or vocational training in Sports Management, Media/Event Production, Broadcast or a related field – or an equivalent qualification through proven hands-on experience in live sports production.
  • You are set up as a freelancer (self-employed) and can collaborate with L1VE on a project basis across multiple productions.
  • Very good German and English skills (at least fluent, ideally C1 level), written and spoken – you communicate confidently with international production teams, partners and clients. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Willingness to travel at least 50% of your time – you like to be where the production happens, not just in the office.

Why us?

  • The opportunity to shape immersive sports productions and production structures in an international, fast-growing tech and media company.
  • Close collaboration with interdisciplinary teams across Tech, Content & Creation, Brand Partnerships and Post-Production – from first concept to live delivery in the stadium.
  • Direct impact on innovative live formats, international productions and global sports partnerships.
  • Work with state-of-the-art 12K/3D/360° streaming technology and immersive platforms that redefine the live experience.
  • Flexible, freelance, project-based collaboration with the possibility to support one or several productions in parallel, depending on scope and availability.
  • Modern tools and a culture that values ownership, performance, innovation and bold ideas – on and off the field.
  • We offer a competitive freelance compensation depending on experience and project scope.

  • Aufbau, Aufbereitung, Annotation und Qualitätssicherung von Bilddatensätzen

description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. Why Join Us

We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our iOS app, being the #18 productivity app in the App Store category and also our recent recognition as Apple's 2025 Design Award for inclusivity, we find the need for a Senior iOS Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push our missing forward.   

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What You'll Do

  • Opportunity to lead key engineering and product decisions
  • Actively shipping production code for the Speechify iOS app
  • Work within a dedicated product team
  • Participate in product discussions to shape the product roadmap
  • Maintain and enhance the existing complex app architecture

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Experience. You've worked on products that scaled to a large user base
  • Track record. You have worked on various products from inception to decent traction. You have been responsible for engineering the product
  • Customer obsession. We expect every team member whose responsibilities directly impact customers to be constantly obsessed about providing the best possible experience
  • Product thinking. You make thoughtful decisions about the evolution of your product and support internal teams and designers into taking the right direction
  • Speed. You work quickly to generate ideas and know how to decide which things can ship now and what things need time
  • Focus. We're a high-growth startup with a busy, remote team. You know how and when to engage or be heads down
  • Technical skills. Swift, SwiftUI

Technical Requirements:

  • Swift Programming Language
  • SwiftUI experience
  • Experience in Multithreading Programming
  • Working with CI/CD infrastructure
  • Experience with Fastlane
  • SOLID principles, the ability to write every single class according to SOLID
  • Experience with Git and understanding of different Git strategies

What We offer:

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product
  • An entrepreneurial crew that supports risk, intuition, and hustle
  • The opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry
  • A competitive salary, a collegiate atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture
  • Work on a product that millions of people use and where daily feedback includes users sharing that they cried when they first found the product because it was so impactful on their lives
  • Support people with learning differences like Dyslexia, ADD, Low Vision, Concussions, Autism, and Second Language Learners, and give reading superpowers to professionals all over the world
  • Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech: Intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Audio
